 Order
Date : 04.09.2025.
Heard Mr. K.R. Bora, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner.

Also heard Ms. S.H. Bora,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam appearing for the State respondent.

This is an application under Section 528 of the BNSS, 2023 praying for quashing of the FIR of the Dispur P.S. Case No.204/2022, under Section 420/406/376(2)
(n)/384 of the IPC and the Charge Sheet No.134/2022, dated 29.04.2022 and also for setting aside and quashing of the entire proceeding of Sessions Case No.163/2024, pending in the Court of learned Addl. Sessions Judge (FTC) No.4, Kamrup (M) at Guwahati.
Issue notice to the respondents, returnable in 3 (three) weeks.

Since Ms. Bora, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, has entered appearance and accepted notice on behalf of the State respondent No. 1, no formal notice is required to be issued to the said respondent.
However, she shall be provided with requisite extra-copy of the petition during the course of the day.
Petitioner side shall take steps for service of notice on respondent No. 2 by registered post with A/D as well as through usual process within 3 (three) working days from today.

Also, call for the scanned copy of the Trial Court Record.
Page No.# 3/3 Considering the submission of learned counsel for the parties and fact of the case,
further

proceeding against the present petitioner in connection with Sessions Case No.163/2024,
pending in the Court of learned Addl.
Sessions Judge (FTC) No.4, Kamrup (M) at Guwahati, be stayed till the next date of listing.
List the matter after 3 (three) weeks.
